status_at_plan: D0/D1/D2 and original v1 TEST have been inspected. Neither new appearance training arm nor synthetic VAL stress has run.
scope: Exploratory TRAIN/VAL appearance-robustness ablation; no new TEST evaluation, no replacement of v1.

augmentation.both_arms: Original synchronized H/W flips plus image-only signed gamma, independently keyed by case/epoch.
augmentation.gamma_mapping: sign(x)*abs(x)**gamma, then clip[-5,5]; preserve input-zero locations; GT never used.
augmentation.polarity_mapping: Multiply nonzero image values by -1 after same gamma; independent keyed stream, no geometric/mask change.
augmentation.rng: SHA256 of fixed policy/seed/epoch/patient-visit/stream; A and B share gamma draws and do not consume original Torch RNG.
augmentation.not_claimed: A global monotone gamma does not intentionally reverse tissue ordering. Polarity inversion is a synthetic invariance probe, not identified MRI acquisition physics.

fixed_val_stress.gamma_0.7: Signed gamma .7 and clamp5, preserving input zeros.
fixed_val_stress.gamma_1.5: Signed gamma1.5 and clamp5, preserving input zeros.
fixed_val_stress.polarity: Multiply original cached nonzero inputs by -1.
fixed_val_stress.spatial_gain: Multiply original cached input by linearH gain .7..1.3; clamp5. Synthetic cache-space perturbation, not physical bias-field simulation.

selection_metric: Original patient-balanced foreground Dice on clean38 VAL; every epoch evaluated; ties earlier. Stress never selects epoch.
primary_comparisons: gamma_polarity minus gamma_only patient-balanced prostate Dice on clean VAL and separately under polarity stress; retain all6 patient pairs.
Record original seed42 and43 references on the same five conditions; the two references are not new training arms.
secondary_comparisons: Every class Dice/IoU in every condition, worst patient prostate Dice, all38 cases, all6 patient means, training curves and resources.
Describe all five stress responses without picking the best condition or calling repeated conditions independent patients.

engineering_gate.purpose: Only a prespecified development indication for future work, not a statistical superiority claim or replacement v1 selection.
engineering_gate.otherwise: Report lack of support and all negative outcomes; do not tune this recipe or evaluate M015 in response.

compute.preferred: Use immediately available original Rangpur A100 environment; no duplicate cloud allocation. If queued, cloud is an authorized fallback only after both arms can run on the same verified platform.
compute.paired_initial_state_and_runtime: Check both new arm initial parameter SHA and runtime equality after execution; otherwise report a confound and do not claim isolated augmentation effect.
compute.smoke: Before full runs, each arm gets1development epoch with5TRAIN batches and2VAL cases, requiring at least one successful optimizer update. Separate output paths, never used as formal scores.

limits: Post-test motivated design; no untouched new TEST claim or proof M015 is repaired.
Same six validation patients also select checkpoints; stress variants are not new independent patients or clinical acquisition domains.
Only one paired new seed; original CE/maxpool kernels remain warn-only nondeterministic. No bitwise-isolated causal effect or population p-value.
Changing appearance can reduce clean performance; preserve all runs and conditions including failures.
Do not change labels, cached data, original model/loss/optimizer/epochs/selector, v1 scores or Release.
No extra arms, threshold/TTA/ensemble/seed searches or TEST inference in this protocol.

method_sources.use: Gamma range inspiration only; signed cached-space formula is an explicit project adaptation, not nnU-Net reproduction.
General appearance-randomization motivation; this simple gamma/polarity ablation does not implement or claim GIN/IPA.
